title:
让你的 Agent，
接上整个团队。
sub: Your agents. Your team. One place.
voice: 让你的智能助手，接上整个团队。这就是 Greenhouse。
en: Let your agent work with your whole team. This is Greenhouse.

title: 带上你熟悉的 Agent
voice: 连接你熟悉的 Agent，按成员权限，访问团队资源。
en: Connect your own agent to team resources, within your permissions.

title: 答案，有团队的依据
voice: 查知识，读文件，回答有依据，成果有归处。
en: Search knowledge, read files and follow answers back to their sources.

title: 从数据，走到下一步
voice: 分析表格，跟进项目。数据、任务和讨论，都围绕工作展开。
en: Analyze tables and move projects forward, with tasks and discussion together.

title: 把好方法，变成日常
voice: 共享技能，按团队模板生成报告，保存到文件。让重复工作定时完成，随时查看结果。
en: Share skills, create reports from team templates and save them to Files. Schedule recurring work and revisit its results.

title: 在桌前，也在路上
voice: 网页、苹果手机和平板，随时对话、查阅资料、跟进进展。也可以配置飞书机器人。
en: Continue on the web, iPhone and iPad. Chat, find information and follow progress. A Feishu bot is optional.

title: 放手做事，边界清晰
voice: 权限有边界，写入有记录，删除先预览。每一笔付费调用，都有预算。
en: Scoped access, recorded MCP writes and deletion previews. Paid calls count toward clear budgets.

title: 给团队一片生长的空间
voice: 开源，自主部署。让团队一起生长。
en: Open source. Self-hosted. A place for your team to grow.
